'''Heirn''' is the [[sept]] chief of the [[Jindo]] and member of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].

== Appearance ==
He is tall, dark and slender, with a leathery face.

== History ==
His warrior society is ''[[Tain Shari]]''.

== Activities ==
He meets [[Rhuarc]] at [[Rhuidean]] when the Aiel from [[Tear]] are transported through the [[Portal Stone]].{{ref/book|4|23}}

He helps to teach [[Rand al'Thor]] the Aiel way of fighting.

He is present when Rand's forces attack the [[Shaido]] outside [[Cairhien]].

Months later he [[Travel]]s with Rhuarc and the rest of his clan to [[Arad Doman]]. There, he is required to bring peace to the war torn country and find the missing members of the [[Council of Merchants]].
